gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (trimmed p5, printed p18) prints Total revenues 598,922 = General Fund 283,367 + Street Fund 315,429 + Other Governmental Fund (Keno) 126. Detail holds the General Fund departments (pp14-15, 283,367) and the Street Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p13), whose printed actual lines add to 314,929 although it prints Total resources 315,429: the schedule omits the Street Fund 'Grants and contributions' 500 that the statement prints in the Street Fund column (missing line). The Keno column (Licenses and permits 100, Interest income 26; total 126) has no schedule, so it is not in detail (missing fund column). 598,296 + 500 + 100 + 26 = 598,922 = statement total.
